title: MV Out of Ordinary Odysseys (Battle System Display/Thoughts)

posts.author: AnOtterFerox
posts.body:
This is a project I have sat on for a few years on and off now. It's been through different engines and restarted/revised a few times. I thought might as well show off something and get thoughts and feedback on the battle system so I created a demo.
This is more of a hobbie and is
not
planned to be a commercial project.
~
Screenshots:
There is heavy inspiration from the SMT series in this battle system.
Here is a link to the demo through
MediaFire
~
Game Battle System Demo
Note: I tested a download for the demo and it seems to take a few seconds to load; please let me know of any issues. I boxed up the game into one file versus using rpg maker's deployment method.
~
Thanks for showing interests! Let me know yalls thoughts or have ask if you have questions.
~

I have yet to try the Demo; I'll check it out when I get home!
Also, here is some random info that somewhat pertains to your Hud.
In design, when you have a lot of small things clustered together, it's usually more appealing to the eye when they're grouped and "held" or tied together by something. For example, a bunch of loose items on a table or shelf can look messy and cluttered, especially if the things are different shapes and sizes. But when you put them on a plate or a bowl, they look more purposeful and visually appealing even though they are still loose items on a table. This is also why many of HUD displays have buttons grouped on top of windows or boxes. I am not saying you should, but see if you like seeing them grouped up together in separate boxes/windows. It can be a simple colored rectangle.
